content: Azure SRE Agent now supports Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Agent 365 in public preview, so security and IT teams can see and govern SRE agents alongside other agents in the organization. Each agent can have its own Agent ID in addition to its managed identity. Teams can assign Azure roles to the Agent ID so the agent's actions appear as itself in Entra and in Azure activity logs. Through Agent 365, administrators can find SRE agents in the tenant's agent registry and monitor their activity with Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Defender. Learn more.
